name: yss-code-reader
description: Open a yss private preview in a webview, and let its code map open files and resolve definitions in this editor.

yss.url.markdownDescription: The private preview to frame. This is the port `python -m yss serve` uses for the private target; the public preview on 8801 is redacted and carries no source text.

yss.root.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative folder the site's repo-relative paths resolve against. Empty means the first workspace folder, which is right whenever the editor is open on the repository the site was built from.

yss.followSeeks.description: Move the editor every time you follow a link inside the page. Off by default: the page is the thing you are reading, and an editor that jumps under you while you skim is a distraction.
